items.claim: The adjuration-formula seam warrant for Song.3.5 is byte-solid but the rejected alternative is a strawman that never engages the live refrain-into-preceding-unit rival (folding 3:5 into the 3:1-4 seek-find narrative it closes).
items.evidence: oshb:Song.3.5 collates byte-identical (tier: byte) to oshb:Song.2.7's full adjuration form, correctly closing the daughters-of-Jerusalem/gazelles-and-does form; but the row's strongest_rejected_alternative only contests an analogy-vs-own-bytes argumentation point, not the substantive rival that 3:5 could instead be folded into its preceding 3:1-4 night-search unit as its closing bracket rather than argued as adjuration_refrain standalone -- the disclosed setumah at Song.3.5 (tier-3, single-witness) is correctly held as corroboration only, so this is a rival-quality gap, not a boundary error.

items.claim: Song.3.6-3.11 is correctly held as one lyric_address unit under hybrid granularity, with the third-person-description deviation from direct address honestly disclosed and no tier-1 marker at the interior Song.3.8 setumah to force a split.
items.evidence: oshb:Song.3.6 מִ֣י זֹ֗את עֹלָה֙ מִן הַמִּדְבָּ֔ר (tier: byte) opens the mi-zot formula and oshb:Song.3.11 צְאֶ֧ינָה וּֽרְאֶ֛ינָה בְּנ֥וֹת צִיּ֖וֹן (tier: byte) closes on the distinct daughters-of-Zion vocative (sweep: 1 verse for this form, vs the 6-verse daughters-of-Jerusalem pair); the interior setumah at Song.3.8 (tier-3, single-witness) is disclosed as corroboration only, not a driver, consistent with no gender-marked voice-shift forcing an interior cut.

items.claim: The Song.4.1-4.7 wasf_poem bound is exactly the owner-named 4:1-7 zone, closed on a byte-verified inclusio repeating the rayati formula anchor, correctly extending two verses past the raw body-part-token run without over-claiming.
items.evidence: oshb:Song.4.1 הִנָּ֨ךְ יָפָ֤ה רַעְיָתִי֙ (tier: byte) opens and oshb:Song.4.7 כֻּלָּ֤ךְ יָפָה֙ רַעְיָתִ֔י וּמ֖וּם אֵ֥ין בָּֽךְ (tier: byte) closes on the matching רעיתי inclusio; the extension beyond the raw wasf_signal run (Song.4.1-4.5) to include Song.4.6-4.7 is byte-argued from this closural repetition, not the classical assumption, and the strongest_rejected_alternative (extending into Song.4.8's kallah-marked invitation) correctly identifies the live forward rival.

items.claim: Song.4.8-4.15 is correctly held as one continuous single-voice lyric_address with the spice-catalogue verses (4.13-4.14) correctly treated as lyric enumeration rather than an independent register, matching the closed-vocabulary ruling on this book.

items.claim: The Song.4.16 voice attribution to the woman is grounded in the in-verse dodi formula anchor and the my-garden-to-his-garden possessor shift, not the coinciding WEB [Beloved] heading, and the row correctly defers the forward-boundary argument to the following verse's own bytes.

items.claim: Attributing Song.5.1's garden-report clause to 'the man' crosses the 4:16|5:1 voice seam without quoting the gender-marked formula anchor that grounds it, even though that evidence sits in the same verse the row already cites.
items.evidence: oshb:Song.5.1 opens בָּ֣אתִי לְגַנִּי֮ (tier: byte), a 1cs perfect verb that is not gender-marked in Hebrew and cannot itself establish a male speaker; the row's quoted span omits the immediately adjacent אֲחֹתִ֣י כַלָּה֒ vocative (tier: byte, the his-word-for-her formula anchor attested at Song.4.8-4.12) that is the actual tier-1 ground for a male speaker at this cross-part seam following the preceding row's her-voice conclusion at Song.4.16 -- the plural-imperative hedge later in the same row correctly avoids heading-leaning, but the opening man-voice premise itself ships unquoted.

items.claim: Song.5.2-5.8 is the owner-named second night episode, correctly closed on the byte-verified im-timtze'u/mah-tagidu adjuration variant with the refrain-into-preceding-unit rival explicitly engaged and rejected on its own bytes.
items.evidence: oshb:Song.5.8 הִשְׁבַּ֥עְתִּי אֶתְכֶ֖ם בְּנ֣וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם אִֽם תִּמְצְאוּ֙ (tier: byte) matches the device inventory's formula-variation record for 5:8 (gazelles/does absent, mah-variant and im-timtze'u-variant both true), and the row explicitly considers and rejects isolating Song.5.8 as its own adjuration_refrain unit, the exact rival class this lens flags for refrain-closure rows.
